standardize.custom.notes: The actual standardization is model-backed remote computation; this dotted wrapper does not make it a pandas text kernel.

standardize.replace.notes: Python regex performs the replacement; pandas supplies row iteration and output assignment. This is not vectorized pandas string replacement.

structure.split_dictionary.notes: Exact callable alias of split.dictionary. The same underlying core performs the transform; there is no second implementation.

structure.split_list.notes: Exact callable alias of split.list. The same underlying core performs the transform; there is no second implementation.

structure.split_text.notes: Exact callable alias of split.text. The same underlying core performs the transform; there is no second implementation.

structure.tokenize.notes: Exact callable alias of split.tokenize. The same underlying core performs the transform; there is no second implementation.

translate.notes: The service/model backend computes the result through wrangles/translate.py:translate; pandas marshals inputs and assigns responses.

transpose.notes: Pandas performs reshaping and resulting dtype inference.

try.notes: Branch-dependent core stages use Python retry/exception handling; wrangles.recipe.run; pandas.DataFrame.assign; this combines substantive engines rather than only a pandas wrapper.
